filter: Every Run and TrailRun with GPS that starts in New York, San Francisco, Sydney, Christchurch or London, all time. A run belongs to a city when its first GPS point falls inside that city's box (lat south, lat north, lng west, lng east): New York 40.45 41.0 -74.3 -73.65; San Francisco 37.6 37.95 -122.65 -122.3; Sydney -34.15 -33.5 150.9 151.45; Christchurch -43.75 -43.35 172.3 172.9; London 51.25 51.72 -0.55 0.32. Nothing was left out for pace or length, so short warm-ups and a few walk-pace tracks saved as runs are included. Runs with no GPS track (treadmill, manual entries) are not here. Melbourne is deliberately not included.
